scope: Diagnose convective rainfall growth from dense urban rain-gauge fields by comparing observed evolution with an optical-flow advection-only reference and interpreting the residual within explicit measurement limitations.
interpretation_boundary: This QSS run evaluates frozen bibliographic scope groups only. It does not reopen the rejected AMT latent temporal-transition model or authorize temporal-path candidate scoring.
legacy_group_key_note: The runner reads kbs_frozen_evidence_groups; these are independently frozen AMT groups.
